raw_html: [[Static Attraction]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Static Attraction]]:''' This weapon attracts the static electricity in the air, and over time will charge with magic while held in your main hand. Every five seconds, this weapon gains a charge of Static Electricity, up to a maxiumum of 3, providing a +10 Exceptional bonus to Electric Spell Power and a +5% Exceptional bonus to Electric Spell Lore. When you cast an Electric spell, all stacks are consumed.
